note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Angola: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: An employee's (Group A) income is exempt to AOA 150,000 and then taxed by a table rising from 16% to 25% above AOA 10 million (each band a fixed amount plus a rate on the excess).

value.period: not stated in the source (the IRT table is applied to each payment of pay)

figures.applies: 2026; agt.minfin.gov.ao not read in this pass, so PwC is quoted.

sources.said: For Group A, there are progressive income tax rates up to 25%, as follows: Income (AOA) Payable tax (AOA) Up to 150,000 Exempt Between 150,001 and 200,000 12,500 + 16% upon the excess of 150,000

figures.finding: A self-employed worker (Group B) paid by a company or an accounting payer has 6.5% withheld from the fee; otherwise the profit is taxed at 25%, with up to 30% of expenses deductible where records are kept.

sources.said: When the income is paid by companies, or individuals who have a simplified accounting or a general accounting model/organised accounting, the taxable amount corresponds to the value of the service and is subject to WHT at a rate of 6.5%.

Taxpayers maintaining accounting books and records, simplified accounting model, or purchase and sale or services provided registration book are allowed to deduct up to 30% of incurred expenses in the computation of taxable income.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; an employee with only employment income files no return (PAYE is final), a self-employed worker files in March of the next year, and the employer files the annual Modelo 2 by the end of February.

sources.said: The tax year runs from 1 January to 31 December.
Self-employed workers file an annual return disclosing their annual income during March of the following year.

figures.finding: Employment income tax is withheld monthly by the employer under PAYE, and no return is needed for it.

sources.said: Individuals only deriving employment income are not required to file tax returns, as the PIT is withheld at source by their employer.

figures.finding: A non-resident professional's business and professional income is generally subject to a final 6.5% withholding on the gross amount.

sources.said: Business and professional income derived by non-resident professionals is generally subject to final WHT of 6.5% on the gross amount.

figures.finding: Social security is 3% of gross pay from the employee and 8% from the employer (holiday allowance excluded); a foreigner without a residence permit covered at home may be excluded.

sources.said: Individuals are liable to Social security contributions on their gross income at rates of 3% (8%, in case of retired employees) and 8% due by the employee and the employer, respectively.

figures.finding: VAT is 14% at the standard rate (7% under the simplified regime).
figures.applies: 2026; the turnover threshold for the general regime was not read.

sources.said: The standard VAT rate is 14%, and VAT has a broad tax base.

sources.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Angola, Individual - Taxes on personal income (last reviewed 24 June 2026)

sources.said: The tax year runs from 1 January to 31 December. … Self-employed workers file an annual return disclosing their annual income during March of the following year. … Individuals only deriving employment income are not required to file tax returns, as the PIT is withheld at source by their employer.
